turns.answer:
For flying, I'd recommend a 20,000mAh USB-C power bank with 45–65W charging. That's the sweet spot for most travelers: enough capacity to recharge a phone several times, fast enough for many tablets and laptops, and generally within airline battery limits.

The most important thing is to choose a power bank that's under 100Wh (watt-hours), not just one with a high mAh rating.

The FAA requires power banks in carry-on baggage, never checked luggage. Airlines can impose stricter limits on quantity, storage, charging and in-flight use.
